settings.heading: Care instructions
settings.content: Remove the cover and machine wash on a gentle cycle (up to 86°F / 30°C). Air dry completely before putting it back on. Spot-clean the foam with a damp cloth — do not machine wash or tumble dry the foam.

settings.title: Neck stiffness
settings.cause: Sleeping with your neck bent at an awkward angle for hours can leave it tense and stiff in the morning.
settings.solution: The contoured shape cradles the natural curve of your neck, helping keep your head and spine in line.

settings.title: Shoulder tension
settings.cause: Flat or overstuffed pillows can push your shoulders into an uncomfortable position.
settings.solution: Ergonomic side grooves give your shoulders room to rest in a more natural position.

settings.title: Back discomfort
settings.cause: Without proper support, your upper body can sag out of alignment during the night.
settings.solution: A supportive structure encourages better overall posture while you sleep.

settings.title: Restless nights
settings.cause: Constant tossing and turning is often a sign of pressure points and poor support.
settings.solution: Adaptive memory foam distributes pressure evenly, so you can settle in and stay comfortable.

settings.title: Morning headaches
settings.cause: Poor head and neck positioning can build up muscle tension overnight.
settings.solution: Steady alignment helps reduce tension, so you wake up feeling fresher.

settings.title: Noisy breathing
settings.cause: An awkward head position can affect how comfortably you breathe at night.
settings.solution: Helps keep your head and neck well positioned for a calmer, quieter rest.

settings.heading: Why you wake up sore — and what you can do about it

settings.heading: Say goodbye to waking up stiff

settings.text:
Do you wake up tired, tense or with a stiff neck? Tossing and turning, morning headaches and tight shoulders can all be signs that your pillow isn't giving you the support you need.

Traditional pillows often fail to keep your neck and spine aligned, forcing your body into awkward positions all night long.

Now imagine waking up rested and ready for the day.

Pillowvia is designed to give your neck precise ergonomic support, helping keep it in its most natural position while you rest.

The right support helps reduce tension and discomfort, so you can wake up more comfortable — night after night.

settings.title: For side sleepers
settings.text: The raised side grooves keep your neck aligned and give your shoulder room for a more natural position.

settings.title: For back sleepers
settings.text: Rest your head in the lower center area for gentle, natural support of your head and neck.

settings.title: For stomach sleepers

Not completely satisfied? We'll refund you. No risk — you only keep it if it's the right pillow for you.

settings.heading: Is a pillowcase included?
settings.row_content: Yes — every pillow comes with a soft, removable cover shaped to fit the ergonomic design. Standard pillowcases may not fit the contour as well, so we recommend using the included cover.

settings.heading: How do I clean the pillow and the cover?
settings.row_content: The cover is machine washable on a gentle cycle (up to 86°F / 30°C) — air dry or tumble dry on low. The foam should not be machine washed: simply spot-clean it with a damp cloth and let it air dry.

settings.heading: How long does it take to get used to it?
settings.row_content: Because the pillow encourages a new, more natural sleeping posture, the first few nights may feel different — that's completely normal. Most people adjust within a few nights; for some it can take 1–2 weeks.

settings.heading: Which side should I use?
settings.row_content: The pillow has two heights: a lower center for back sleepers and higher sides for side sleepers. You can rotate it 180° and use whichever side feels best for you.

settings.heading: Is it hypoallergenic?
settings.row_content: The pillow is made with latex-free memory foam and a breathable cover, which makes it a great choice for people with sensitive skin.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. All payments are processed securely with SSL encryption.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.row_content: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days. Delivery within the US typically takes 7–15 business days. As soon as your order ships, you'll receive an email with your tracking number.

settings.heading: What if it's not right for me?
settings.row_content: You have 100 nights to try your pillow at home. If you're not satisfied, contact us and we'll help you with a return and refund — no complicated questions.
